answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before transacting; the stake is slashed on provable misbehavior. Newcomers start on a probationary terrace with low rate limits and must earn reputation through attested work before full limits apply, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs real capital each. A saffron-colored, tamper-evident credential badge, issued only after verified work, marks earned identities and lets peers price trust without a central gatekeeper.
